description: Narrow namespace-parametric disjoint_left bridge. For a theorem whose namespace is Set or Multiset and whose name or goal mentions disjointness, the gate emits the matching `simp [<NS>.disjoint_left]` rewrite and its depth-2 `<;> aesop` form. Fires ONLY on Set/Multiset disjoint goals; cannot fire on Nat/List/Finset/Order goals (namespace mismatch) or on Set/Multiset goals that never mention disjointness.
allowlist_source: TR3 (3 Set wins) + TR5 (3 Set reproductions, rank 1) + TR6 (8 fresh wins: 4 Multiset + 4 Set)

namespace_split.note: If Set and Multiset behave very differently under validation, report and (if needed) promote them as separate RC4B_Set / RC4B_Multiset candidates.

excluded_from_this_candidate: Finset.disjoint_left and all Finset disjoint lemmas (not independently evidenced; kept as negative control)
broad simp with all disjoint lemmas / simp [*, disjoint]
arbitrary d2_simp_aesop with any retrieved lemma (RC4C, validated separately)
evaluation_rule: candidate_solved = literal_RC2_solved OR (gate fires AND at least one gated bridge tactic closes the goal single-shot from the initial state)
